<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>AI Traffic Sign Recognition</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#0a1128; --bg2:#0d1b3d; --card:#0f1f45; --card2:#0c1836;
    --border:#1c2f5e; --text:#eaf0ff; --sub:#8ba0d0; --muted:#5f74a6;
    --cyan:#22e0d8; --green:#3ddc84; --orange:#f5a623; --purple:#a06bf5; --red:#ff5470; --blue:#3b82f6;
    --font-display: 'Space Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    --font-body: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Consolas', monospace;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0;}
  body{
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 15% 0%, #101f4a 0%, var(--bg) 45%) fixed;
    color:var(--text); font-family:var(--font-body); min-height:100vh; display:flex;
  }
  a{color:inherit}
  ::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px;height:8px}
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#22345f;border-radius:4px}

  /* Sidebar */
  .sidebar{
    width:230px; min-width:230px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0c1836,#091430);
    border-right:1px solid var(--border); padding:22px 14px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px;
  }
  .brand{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:6px 10px 22px 10px;}
  .brand-icon{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--cyan),var(--blue));
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:17px;flex:none;}
  .brand-text{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:700; font-size:14px; line-height:1.25; letter-spacing:0.02em;}
  .brand-text span{display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted); font-weight:500; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase;}
  .nav-item{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; padding:10px 12px; border-radius:9px; cursor:pointer;
    color:var(--sub); font-size:13.5px; font-weight:500; transition:.15s; border:1px solid transparent;
  }
  .nav-item:hover{background:#132248; color:var(--text);}
  .nav-item.active{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#173064,#122448); color:#fff; border-color:#274a8f;}
  .nav-item .ic{width:17px;text-align:center;font-size:14px;}
  .sidebar-foot{margin-top:auto; padding:12px 10px; font-size:10.5px; color:var(--muted); border-top:1px solid var(--border); padding-top:14px;}
  .model-badge{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:11px;color:var(--green);margin-bottom:6px;}
  .dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--green);}

  /* Main */
  .main{flex:1; min-width:0; padding:26px 30px 50px; max-width:1500px;}
  .topbar{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; margin-bottom:26px; gap:20px;}
  h1{font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:26px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.01em;}
  .subtitle{color:var(--sub); font-size:13px; margin-top:5px;}
  .topbar-right{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; color:var(--sub); font-size:12.5px;}
  .clock{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px; background:var(--card2); border:1px solid var(--border); padding:9px 14px; border-radius:11px;}

  .panel-title{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:14px;}
  .panel-title h2{font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:12.5px; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--cyan); font-weight:600;}
  .card{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--card),var(--card2)); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:16px; padding:20px;}

  .grid-top{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr; gap:18px; margin-bottom:18px;}
  @media(max-width:1050px){.grid-top{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

  .detect-tabs{display:flex; gap:8px; margin-bottom:14px;}
  .dtab{padding:7px 14px; border-radius:8px; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; color:var(--sub); border:1px solid var(--border); background:var(--card2);}
  .dtab.active{background:var(--cyan); color:#04222a; border-color:var(--cyan);}

  .stage{position:relative; border-radius:12px; overflow:hidden; background:#050b1e; border:1px solid var(--border); aspect-ratio:16/10; display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
  .stage video, .stage img.stage-img{width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; display:block;}
  .stage canvas.overlay{position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; pointer-events:none;}
  .stage-placeholder{color:var(--muted); font-size:13px; text-align:center; padding:20px;}
  .stage-placeholder .big{font-size:34px; display:block; margin-bottom:10px;}
  .stage-caption{position:absolute; left:14px; bottom:14px; background:rgba(5,11,30,0.88); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; padding:9px 13px; font-size:12px; max-width:80%;}
  .stage-caption b{font-size:13px;}
  .stage-caption .conf{color:var(--green); font-weight:700;}

  .stage-controls{display:flex; gap:10px; margin-top:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center;}
  .btn{background:var(--card2); border:1px solid var(--border); color:var(--text); padding:9px 15px; border-radius:9px; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; transition:.15s;}
  .btn:hover{border-color:var(--cyan); color:var(--cyan);}
  .btn.primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--cyan),#1aa8c9); color:#03222a; border:none;}
  .btn.primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.08); color:#03222a;}
  .btn:disabled{opacity:.4; cursor:not-allowed;}
  input[type=file]{display:none;}
  .fps-tag{margin-left:auto; font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); font-family:var(--font-mono);}

  .gallery{display:flex; gap:9px; margin-top:13px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .gallery img{width:52px; height:52px; border-radius:9px; object-fit:cover; cursor:pointer; border:2px solid var(--border); transition:.15s;}
  .gallery img:hover{border-color:var(--cyan); transform:translateY(-2px);}

  .detected-card{display:flex; gap:16px; align-items:flex-start;}
  .detected-sign-icon{width:96px;height:96px;border-radius:16px;background:#050b1e;border:1px solid var(--border); flex:none; display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center; overflow:hidden;}
  .detected-sign-icon img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
  .detected-info{flex:1; min-width:0;}
  .detected-info .name{font-size:17px; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:8px; font-family:var(--font-display);}
  .kv{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size:12px; color:var(--sub); margin-top:9px; padding-top:9px; border-top:1px solid var(--border);}
  .kv:first-of-type{border-top:none; padding-top:0; margin-top:12px;}
  .kv b{color:var(--text); font-weight:600;}
  .conf-big{color:var(--green); font-weight:700; font-family:var(--font-mono);}
  .cat-tag{color:var(--blue); font-weight:600;}
  .empty-detect{color:var(--muted); font-size:12.5px; padding:10px 0; line-height:1.6;}

  .stats-row{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:16px; margin-bottom:18px;}
  @media(max-width:950px){.stats-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}}
  .stat-card{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--card),var(--card2)); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:14px; padding:16px 18px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start;}
  .stat-card .label{font-size:10.5px; letter-spacing:0.09em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); font-weight:600; margin-bottom:8px;}
  .stat-card .value{font-size:23px; font-weight:700; font-family:var(--font-display);}
  .stat-icon{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px; flex:none;}

  .grid-bottom{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr 1fr; gap:18px;}
  @media(max-width:1200px){.grid-bottom{grid-template-columns:1fr; }}

  .chart-wrap{height:210px; position:relative;}
  .donut-wrap{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px;}
  .legend{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:11px; font-size:12px;}
  .legend .row{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; justify-content:space-between;}
  .legend .sw{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:3px;}
  .legend .name{color:var(--sub); flex:1;}
  .legend b{font-family:var(--font-mono);}

  .history-list{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; max-height:230px; overflow-y:auto;}
  .hist-item{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; padding:9px 10px; border-radius:10px; background:var(--card2); border:1px solid var(--border);}
  .hist-icon{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px; flex:none; overflow:hidden; display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center; background:#050b1e; font-size:15px;}
  .hist-icon img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
  .hist-name{font-size:12.5px; font-weight:600;}
  .hist-time{font-size:10.5px; color:var(--muted);}
  .hist-conf{margin-left:auto; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; color:var(--green); font-family:var(--font-mono);}
  .hist-empty{color:var(--muted); font-size:12px; padding:20px 5px; text-align:center;}

  .foot-note{text-align:center; color:var(--muted); font-size:11.5px; margin-top:30px; padding-top:18px; border-top:1px solid var(--border);}
  .foot-note b{color:var(--sub)}

  .badge-real{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; font-size:10px; color:var(--green); background:rgba(61,220,132,0.1); border:1px solid rgba(61,220,132,0.3); padding:3px 8px; border-radius:20px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.02em;}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="sidebar">
  <div class="brand">
    <div class="brand-icon">🚦</div>
    <div class="brand-text">TrafficSign AI<span>CNN · OpenCV Engine</span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="nav-item active" data-tab="dashboard"><span class="ic">🏠</span> Dashboard</div>
  <div class="nav-item" data-tab="live"><span class="ic">📷</span> Live Detection</div>
  <div class="nav-item" data-tab="upload"><span class="ic">⬆️</span> Image Upload</div>
  <div class="nav-item" data-tab="history"><span class="ic">🕒</span> History</div>
  <div class="nav-item" data-tab="stats"><span class="ic">📊</span> Statistics</div>
  <div class="nav-item" data-tab="model"><span class="ic">🧠</span> Model Info</div>
  <div class="sidebar-foot">
    <div class="model-badge"><span class="dot"></span> Model loaded &amp; ready</div>
    52 classes · 32×32 input<br>Trained in-browser, numpy CNN
  </div>
</div>

<div class="main">
  <div class="topbar">
    <div>
      <h1>AI Traffic Sign Recognition</h1>
      <div class="subtitle">CNN · OpenCV-preprocessed · Live classification running client-side in your browser</div>
    </div>
    <div class="topbar-right">
      <div class="clock">📅 <span id="clockDate"></span>&nbsp;&nbsp;🕐 <span id="clockTime"></span></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="grid-top">
    <div class="card">
      <div class="panel-title">
        <h2 id="stageLabel">LIVE WEBCAM DETECTION</h2>
        <div class="detect-tabs">
          <div class="dtab active" data-mode="webcam">Webcam</div>
          <div class="dtab" data-mode="upload">Upload</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="stage" id="stage">
        <div class="stage-placeholder" id="stagePlaceholder">
          <span class="big">📷</span>
          Start the webcam, or drop in an image, to run the real CNN.<br>Or click a sample sign below.
        </div>
        <video id="video" autoplay playsinline muted style="display:none"></video>
        <img id="uploadedImg" class="stage-img" style="display:none">
        <div class="stage-caption" id="stageCaption" style="display:none"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="stage-controls">
        <button class="btn primary" id="btnStart">▶ Start Webcam</button>
        <button class="btn" id="btnStop" disabled>■ Stop</button>
        <button class="btn" id="btnUploadTrigger">⬆ Upload Image</button>
        <input type="file" id="fileInput" accept="image/*">
        <span class="fps-tag" id="fpsTag"></span>
      </div>
      <div class="gallery" id="gallery"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
      <div class="panel-title"><h2>DETECTED SIGN</h2></div>
      <div id="detectedEmpty" class="empty-detect">No detection yet. Start the webcam, upload a photo of a sign, or click a sample thumbnail — inference runs the actual trained CNN right here in your browser.</div>
      <div id="detectedCard" class="detected-card" style="display:none">
        <div class="detected-sign-icon"><img id="detIcon"></div>
        <div class="detected-info">
          <div class="name" id="detName">—</div>
          <div class="kv"><span>Confidence</span><b class="conf-big" id="detConf">—</b></div>
          <div class="kv"><span>Category</span><b class="cat-tag" id="detCat">—</b></div>
          <div class="kv"><span>Class ID</span><b id="detId">—</b></div>
          <div class="kv"><span>Inference time</span><b id="detTime">—</b></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="stats-row">
    <div class="stat-card">
      <div><div class="label">Test Accuracy</div><div class="value" id="statAcc">—</div></div>
      <div class="stat-icon" style="background:rgba(61,220,132,.12); color:var(--green);">✔</div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-card">
      <div><div class="label">Training Images</div><div class="value" id="statTrain">—</div></div>
      <div class="stat-icon" style="background:rgba(59,130,246,.12); color:var(--blue);">🗂</div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-card">
      <div><div class="label">Sign Classes</div><div class="value" id="statClasses">—</div></div>
      <div class="stat-icon" style="background:rgba(245,166,35,.12); color:var(--orange);">🚸</div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-card">
      <div><div class="label">Session Predictions</div><div class="value" id="statPreds">0</div></div>
      <div class="stat-icon" style="background:rgba(160,107,245,.12); color:var(--purple);">⚡</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="grid-bottom">
    <div class="card">
      <div class="panel-title"><h2>ACCURACY OVER TRAINING</h2></div>
      <div class="chart-wrap"><canvas id="accChart"></canvas></div>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <div class="panel-title"><h2>DATASET BY CATEGORY</h2></div>
      <div class="donut-wrap">
        <div style="width:130px;height:130px;flex:none;"><canvas id="donutChart"></canvas></div>
        <div class="legend" id="legendWrap"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="card">
      <div class="panel-title"><h2>RECENT DETECTIONS <span class="badge-real">● live, this session</span></h2></div>
      <div class="history-list" id="historyList"><div class="hist-empty">Nothing detected yet this session.</div></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="foot-note">
    AI Traffic Sign Recognition — a <b>from-scratch CNN (NumPy conv/pool/dense + Adam)</b> trained on <b id="footTrainCount">—</b> images across <b id="footClassCount">—</b> classes, exported and run <b>entirely client-side</b> in this page — no server, no API calls.
  </div>
</div>

<script>
/* ===================== date/clock ===================== */
function tick(){
  const d = new Date();
  document.getElementById('clockDate').textContent = d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{day:'2-digit',month:'short',year:'numeric'});
  document.getElementById('clockTime').textContent = d.toLocaleTimeString('en-US');
}
tick(); setInterval(tick,1000);

/* ===================== CNN forward pass (mirrors training arch) ===================== */
function b64ToFloat32(b64){
  const bin = atob(b64);
  const buf = new ArrayBuffer(bin.length);
  const view = new Uint8Array(buf);
  for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++) view[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
  return new Float32Array(buf);
}

class NDArr{
  constructor(data, shape){ this.data=data; this.shape=shape; }
}

function conv2d(input, W, b, wShape, pad){
  // input: NDArr with shape [H,W,C], W flat Float32Array shape [k,k,Cin,Cout]
  const [H,Wd,C] = input.shape;
  const [k,k2,Cin,Cout] = wShape;
  const oh = H, ow = Wd; // pad=1, stride1, k=3 -> same size
  const out = new Float32Array(oh*ow*Cout);
  const Hp = H+2*pad, Wp = Wd+2*pad;
  const padded = new Float32Array(Hp*Wp*C);
  for(let y=0;y<H;y++) for(let x=0;x<Wd;x++) for(let c=0;c<C;c++)
    padded[((y+pad)*Wp+(x+pad))*C+c] = input.data[(y*Wd+x)*C+c];
  for(let oy=0; oy<oh; oy++){
    for(let ox=0; ox<ow; ox++){
      for(let co=0; co<Cout; co++){
        let sum = b[co];
        for(let ky=0; ky<k; ky++){
          for(let kx=0; kx<k; kx++){
            const py = oy+ky, px = ox+kx;
            const pBase = (py*Wp+px)*C;
            const wBase = ((ky*k+kx)*Cin)*Cout + co;
            for(let ci=0; ci<Cin; ci++){
              sum += padded[pBase+ci] * W[wBase + ci*Cout];
            }
          }
        }
        out[(oy*ow+ox)*Cout+co] = sum;
      }
    }
  }
  return new NDArr(out, [oh,ow,Cout]);
}
function relu(nd){ const d=nd.data; for(let i=0;i<d.length;i++) if(d[i]<0) d[i]=0; return nd; }
function maxpool2(nd){
  const [H,Wd,C] = nd.shape;
  const oh=H>>1, ow=Wd>>1;
  const out = new Float32Array(oh*ow*C);
  for(let y=0;y<oh;y++) for(let x=0;x<ow;x++) for(let c=0;c<C;c++){
    const a=nd.data[((2*y)*Wd+2*x)*C+c], bb=nd.data[((2*y)*Wd+2*x+1)*C+c],
          cc=nd.data[((2*y+1)*Wd+2*x)*C+c], dd=nd.data[((2*y+1)*Wd+2*x+1)*C+c];
    out[(y*ow+x)*C+c] = Math.max(a,bb,cc,dd);
  }
  return new NDArr(out, [oh,ow,C]);
}
function dense(vec, W, b, nIn, nOut){
  const out = new Float32Array(nOut);
  for(let o=0;o<nOut;o++){
    let sum = b[o];
    for(let i=0;i<nIn;i++) sum += vec[i]*W[i*nOut+o];
    out[o]=sum;
  }
  return out;
}
function softmax(v){
  let m=-Infinity; for(const x of v) if(x>m) m=x;
  let s=0; const out=new Float32Array(v.length);
  for(let i=0;i<v.length;i++){ out[i]=Math.exp(v[i]-m); s+=out[i]; }
  for(let i=0;i<v.length;i++) out[i]/=s;
  return out;
}

let LAYERS = null;
function buildModel(){
  LAYERS = DATA.weights.layers.map(l=>{
    if(l.W_b64){
      return {type:l.type, pad:l.pad, W: b64ToFloat32(l.W_b64), b: b64ToFloat32(l.b_b64), shape: l.W_shape};
    }
    return {type:l.type};
  });
}

function runInference(imgData32){
  // imgData32: Float32Array length 32*32*3, values 0..1, HWC RGB
  let x = new NDArr(imgData32, [32,32,3]);
  for(const l of LAYERS){
    if(l.type==='Conv2D'){ x = conv2d(x, l.W, l.b, l.shape, l.pad); }
    else if(l.type==='ReLU'){ x = relu(x); }
    else if(l.type==='MaxPool2x2'){ x = maxpool2(x); }
    else if(l.type==='Flatten'){ x = new NDArr(x.data, [x.data.length]); }
    else if(l.type==='Dense'){
      const nIn=l.shape[0], nOut=l.shape[1];
      x = new NDArr(dense(x.data, l.W, l.b, nIn, nOut), [nOut]);
    }
    else if(l.type==='Dropout'){ /* inference: no-op */ }
  }
  return softmax(x.data);
}

/* ===================== image -> 32x32x3 float tensor ===================== */
function imageToTensor(sourceCanvas){
  const ctx = sourceCanvas.getContext('2d');
  const id = ctx.getImageData(0,0,32,32).data;
  const out = new Float32Array(32*32*3);
  for(let i=0;i<32*32;i++){
    out[i*3+0] = id[i*4+0]/255;
    out[i*3+1] = id[i*4+1]/255;
    out[i*3+2] = id[i*4+2]/255;
  }
  return out;
}
const tmpCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
tmpCanvas.width=32; tmpCanvas.height=32;
const tmpCtx = tmpCanvas.getContext('2d');

function classify(sourceEl, cropSquare){
  // draw source (video/image) center-cropped square into 32x32
  let sw, sh, sx, sy;
  if(sourceEl.tagName==='VIDEO'){ sw=sourceEl.videoWidth; sh=sourceEl.videoHeight; }
  else { sw=sourceEl.naturalWidth; sh=sourceEl.naturalHeight; }
  if(!sw || !sh) return null;
  const side = Math.min(sw,sh);
  sx = (sw-side)/2; sy=(sh-side)/2;
  tmpCtx.drawImage(sourceEl, sx, sy, side, side, 0, 0, 32, 32);
  const tensor = imageToTensor(tmpCanvas);
  const t0 = performance.now();
  const probs = runInference(tensor);
  const t1 = performance.now();
  let best=0; for(let i=1;i<probs.length;i++) if(probs[i]>probs[best]) best=i;
  return {classId:best, confidence:probs[best], ms:(t1-t0)};
}

/* ===================== UI wiring ===================== */
let sessionPreds = 0;
let historyItems = [];

function labelIcon(classId, thumbDataUrl){
  return thumbDataUrl || null;
}

function showDetection(result, thumbDataUrl){
  const name = DATA.labels[result.classId];
  const cat = DATA.categories[result.classId];
  document.getElementById('detectedEmpty').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('detectedCard').style.display='flex';
  document.getElementById('detIcon').src = thumbDataUrl;
  document.getElementById('detName').textContent = name;
  document.getElementById('detConf').textContent = (result.confidence*100).toFixed(2)+'%';
  document.getElementById('detCat').textContent = cat;
  document.getElementById('detId').textContent = '#'+result.classId;
  document.getElementById('detTime').textContent = result.ms.toFixed(1)+' ms';

  const cap = document.getElementById('stageCaption');
  cap.style.display='block';
  cap.innerHTML = '<b>'+name+'</b><br>Confidence: <span class="conf">'+(result.confidence*100).toFixed(2)+'%</span>';

  sessionPreds++;
  document.getElementById('statPreds').textContent = sessionPreds;

  historyItems.unshift({name, conf:result.confidence, thumb:thumbDataUrl, time:new Date()});
  historyItems = historyItems.slice(0,8);
  renderHistory();
}

function renderHistory(){
  const el = document.getElementById('historyList');
  if(historyItems.length===0){ el.innerHTML = '<div class="hist-empty">Nothing detected yet this session.</div>'; return; }
  el.innerHTML = historyItems.map(h=>`
    <div class="hist-item">
      <div class="hist-icon">${h.thumb? `<img src="${h.thumb}">` : '🚦'}</div>
      <div>
        <div class="hist-name">${h.name}</div>
        <div class="hist-time">${h.time.toLocaleTimeString()}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="hist-conf">${(h.conf*100).toFixed(1)}%</div>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

/* --- FIXED WEBCAM --- */
const video = document.getElementById('video');
const stagePH = document.getElementById('stagePlaceholder');
const uploadedImg = document.getElementById('uploadedImg');
const startBtn = document.getElementById('btnStart');
const stopBtn = document.getElementById('btnStop');
const fpsTag = document.getElementById('fpsTag');

let stream = null;
let loopHandle = null;
let webcamStarting = false;
let lastPredictionTime = 0;

function clearWebcamLoop(){
  if(loopHandle){
    clearTimeout(loopHandle);
    loopHandle = null;
  }
}

function stopWebcam(showPlaceholder=true){
  clearWebcamLoop();

  if(stream){
    stream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
    stream = null;
  }

  video.pause();
  video.srcObject = null;

  if(showPlaceholder){
    video.style.display = 'none';
    uploadedImg.style.display = 'none';
    stagePH.style.display = 'flex';
  }

  startBtn.disabled = false;
  stopBtn.disabled = true;
  fpsTag.textContent = '';
}

function cameraErrorMessage(error){
  switch(error?.name){
    case 'NotAllowedError':
      return 'Camera permission was denied. Click the camera icon in the browser address bar and set Camera to Allow, then refresh.';
    case 'NotFoundError':
      return 'No camera was found. Check that your webcam is connected and enabled in Windows.';
    case 'NotReadableError':
      return 'The camera is already being used by another application. Close Windows Camera, Zoom, Teams, Meet, OBS, WhatsApp, etc., then try again.';
    case 'OverconstrainedError':
      return 'The requested camera settings are not supported. The application will retry with basic webcam settings.';
    case 'SecurityError':
      return 'The browser blocked camera access. Open this page through http://localhost:8000 instead of file://.';
    default:
      return error?.message || 'Unknown camera error.';
  }
}

async function getCameraStream(){
  if(!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia){
    throw new Error('Webcam API is unavailable. Use a current version of Chrome or Edge and open the project through localhost.');
  }

  // First attempt: normal Windows/laptop webcam. No environment-camera constraint.
  try{
    return await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
      video: {
        width: {ideal: 1280},
        height: {ideal: 720},
        frameRate: {ideal: 30, max: 30}
      },
      audio: false
    });
  }catch(firstError){
    // Fallback: let the browser choose any available video camera.
    if(firstError.name === 'OverconstrainedError' || firstError.name === 'NotFoundError'){
      return await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({video:true, audio:false});
    }
    throw firstError;
  }
}

async function waitForVideoReady(timeoutMs=15000){
  if(video.readyState >= HTMLMediaElement.HAVE_METADATA && video.videoWidth > 0 && video.videoHeight > 0){
    return;
  }

  await new Promise((resolve, reject)=>{
    let finished = false;

    const cleanup = ()=>{
      video.removeEventListener('loadedmetadata', onReady);
      video.removeEventListener('canplay', onReady);
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };

    const onReady = ()=>{
      if(finished) return;
      if(video.videoWidth > 0 && video.videoHeight > 0){
        finished = true;
        cleanup();
        resolve();
      }
    };

    const timer = setTimeout(()=>{
      if(finished) return;
      finished = true;
      cleanup();
      reject(new Error('Camera stream opened, but the browser did not provide video frames within 15 seconds.'));
    }, timeoutMs);

    video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', onReady);
    video.addEventListener('canplay', onReady);
    onReady();
  });
}

startBtn.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
  if(webcamStarting || stream) return;
  webcamStarting = true;

  clearWebcamLoop();
  startBtn.disabled = true;
  startBtn.textContent = '⏳ Starting Camera...';

  try{
    stopWebcam(false);
    stream = await getCameraStream();

    video.srcObject = stream;
    video.style.display = 'block';
    uploadedImg.style.display = 'none';
    stagePH.style.display = 'none';

    await waitForVideoReady();
    await video.play();

    stopBtn.disabled = false;
    startBtn.disabled = true;
    startBtn.textContent = '▶ Start Webcam';

    const track = stream.getVideoTracks()[0];
    const settings = track?.getSettings?.() || {};
    fpsTag.textContent = `${settings.width || video.videoWidth}×${settings.height || video.videoHeight} · LIVE`;

    runWebcamLoop();
  }catch(error){
    console.error('Webcam startup error:', error);
    stopWebcam(true);
    alert('Could not start webcam.\n\n' + cameraErrorMessage(error));
  }finally{
    webcamStarting = false;
    startBtn.textContent = '▶ Start Webcam';
  }
});

stopBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>stopWebcam(true));

function runWebcamLoop(){
  if(!stream) return;

  if(video.readyState < HTMLMediaElement.HAVE_CURRENT_DATA || video.videoWidth === 0 || video.videoHeight === 0){
    loopHandle = setTimeout(runWebcamLoop, 250);
    return;
  }

  const frameStart = performance.now();

  try{
    const result = classify(video, true);

    if(result){
      const thumbCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      thumbCanvas.width = 48;
      thumbCanvas.height = 48;
      thumbCanvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(tmpCanvas, 0, 0, 48, 48);
      showDetection(result, thumbCanvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.82));

      const frameMs = performance.now() - frameStart;
      const fps = 1000 / Math.max(frameMs, 1);
      fpsTag.textContent = `${fps.toFixed(1)} fps · ${result.ms.toFixed(0)}ms inference`;
    }
  }catch(error){
    console.error('Live inference error:', error);
  }

  loopHandle = setTimeout(runWebcamLoop, 700);
}

// Stop webcam automatically if the browser/device ends the video track.
function watchCameraTrack(){
  if(!stream) return;
  const track = stream.getVideoTracks()[0];
  if(track){
    track.addEventListener('ended', ()=>{
      if(stream){
        stopWebcam(true);
        alert('The webcam was disconnected or stopped by the operating system.');
      }
    }, {once:true});
  }
}

// Patch the start flow with track monitoring without changing the UI.
const originalStartForTrackWatch = startBtn;
startBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  setTimeout(watchCameraTrack, 500);
});

/* --- upload --- */
document.getElementById('btnUploadTrigger').addEventListener('click', ()=> document.getElementById('fileInput').click());
document.getElementById('fileInput').addEventListener('change', (e)=>{
  const file = e.target.files[0];
  if(!file) return;
  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = (ev)=>{
    uploadedImg.src = ev.target.result;
    uploadedImg.onload = ()=>{
      if(stream){ stream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop()); stream=null; }
      if(loopHandle) clearTimeout(loopHandle);
      video.style.display='none'; stagePH.style.display='none'; uploadedImg.style.display='block';
      document.getElementById('btnStart').disabled=false; document.getElementById('btnStop').disabled=true;
      const result = classify(uploadedImg, true);
      if(result) showDetection(result, uploadedImg.src);
    };
  };
  reader.readAsDataURL(file);
});

/* --- sample gallery --- */
function buildGallery(){
  const g = document.getElementById('gallery');
  g.innerHTML = DATA.samples.map((s,i)=>`<img data-idx="${i}" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,${s.b64}" title="${s.name}">`).join('');
  g.querySelectorAll('img').forEach(img=>{
    img.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      if(stream){ stream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop()); stream=null; }
      if(loopHandle) clearTimeout(loopHandle);
      video.style.display='none'; stagePH.style.display='none';
      uploadedImg.style.display='block'; uploadedImg.src = img.src;
      document.getElementById('btnStart').disabled=false; document.getElementById('btnStop').disabled=true;
      uploadedImg.onload = ()=>{
        const result = classify(uploadedImg, true);
        if(result) showDetection(result, uploadedImg.src);
      };
      if(uploadedImg.complete) uploadedImg.onload();
    });
  });
}

/* --- detect tabs (cosmetic label swap) --- */
document.querySelectorAll('.dtab').forEach(t=>{
  t.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    document.querySelectorAll('.dtab').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));
    t.classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('stageLabel').textContent = t.dataset.mode==='webcam' ? 'LIVE WEBCAM DETECTION' : 'IMAGE UPLOAD DETECTION';
    if(t.dataset.mode==='upload') document.getElementById('btnUploadTrigger').click();
    else document.getElementById('btnStart').click();
  });
});

/* --- sidebar nav (scroll to relevant section, cosmetic single-page) --- */
document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(n=>{
  n.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));
    n.classList.add('active');
    const tab = n.dataset.tab;
    if(tab==='live'){ document.querySelector('.dtab[data-mode="webcam"]').click(); }
    if(tab==='upload'){ document.querySelector('.dtab[data-mode="upload"]').click(); }
    document.querySelector('.grid-top').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
  });
});

/* ===================== stats + charts ===================== */
function fillStats(){
  const ds = DATA.datasetStats;
  document.getElementById('statAcc').textContent = (DATA.history.test_acc*100).toFixed(1)+'%';
  document.getElementById('statTrain').textContent = ds.trainImages.toLocaleString();
  document.getElementById('statClasses').textContent = ds.numClasses;
  document.getElementById('footTrainCount').textContent = ds.trainImages.toLocaleString();
  document.getElementById('footClassCount').textContent = ds.numClasses;
}

function drawAccChart(){
  const canvas = document.getElementById('accChart');
  const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio||1;
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  canvas.width = rect.width*dpr; canvas.height = 210*dpr;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  ctx.scale(dpr,dpr);
  const W = rect.width, H = 210;
  const pad = {l:34,r:10,t:14,b:24};
  const hist = DATA.history.history;
  const n = hist.length;
  const xAt = i => pad.l + (W-pad.l-pad.r)*(i/(n-1));
  const yAt = v => H-pad.b - (H-pad.t-pad.b)*v;

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#1c2f5e'; ctx.lineWidth=1; ctx.font='10px Inter';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5f74a6';
  [0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1].forEach(v=>{
    const y = yAt(v);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad.l,y); ctx.lineTo(W-pad.r,y); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillText((v*100)+'%', 2, y+3);
  });

  function plot(key, color){
    ctx.beginPath();
    hist.forEach((h,i)=>{
      const x=xAt(i), y=yAt(h[key]);
      if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
    });
    ctx.strokeStyle=color; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.stroke();
    hist.forEach((h,i)=>{
      const x=xAt(i), y=yAt(h[key]);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x,y,2.2,0,7); ctx.fillStyle=color; ctx.fill();
    });
  }
  plot('val_acc', '#22e0d8');
  plot('train_acc', '#3ddc84');

  ctx.fillStyle='#8ba0d0'; ctx.font='11px Inter';
  ctx.fillText('● val', W-90, 16); ctx.fillStyle='#22e0d8'; ctx.fillText('●', W-96,16);
  ctx.fillStyle='#8ba0d0'; ctx.fillText('● train', W-46, 16); ctx.fillStyle='#3ddc84'; ctx.fillText('●', W-52,16);
}

function drawDonut(){
  const canvas = document.getElementById('donutChart');
  const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio||1;
  canvas.width=130*dpr; canvas.height=130*dpr;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); ctx.scale(dpr,dpr);
  const cats = DATA.datasetStats.categoryImageCounts;
  const total = Object.values(cats).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
  const colors = {'Regulatory':'#3b82f6','Warning':'#f5a623','Other':'#a06bf5'};
  let start = -Math.PI/2;
  const cx=65,cy=65,r=58,rw=20;
  Object.entries(cats).forEach(([k,v])=>{
    const frac = v/total;
    const end = start + frac*2*Math.PI;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx,cy,r,start,end);
    ctx.arc(cx,cy,r-rw,end,start,true);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = colors[k];
    ctx.fill();
    start = end;
  });
  ctx.fillStyle='#eaf0ff'; ctx.font='bold 15px Space Grotesk, sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText(total.toLocaleString(), 65, 62);
  ctx.fillStyle='#8ba0d0'; ctx.font='10px Inter';
  ctx.fillText('images', 65, 76);

  const legend = document.getElementById('legendWrap');
  legend.innerHTML = Object.entries(cats).map(([k,v])=>`
    <div class="row"><span class="sw" style="background:${colors[k]}"></span><span class="name">${k}</span><b>${((v/total)*100).toFixed(0)}%</b></div>
  `).join('');
}

/* ===================== init ===================== */
buildModel();
fillStats();
buildGallery();
drawAccChart();
drawDonut();
window.addEventListener('resize', ()=>{ drawAccChart(); });
</script>
</body>
</html>
